outcome: CTRP6 mRNA expression in subcutaneous white adipose tissue (sWAT)
CTRP6 mRNA expression in omental white adipose tissue (oWAT)
CTRP6 mRNA expression in visceral white adipose tissue (vWAT)
CTRP6 mRNA expression in interscapular brown adipose tissue (iBAT)
cohort: Chinese Han pregnant women (9 GDM, 10 control) undergoing scheduled caesarean section delivery, and high-fat diet induced-pregnancy C57BL/6 mice as an animal model of GDM.
finding: CTRP6 levels were dynamically expressed during pregnancy, showing a decrease in early trimesters but significantly increasing at delivery in both GDM patients (in plasma, sWAT, oWAT, and placenta) and GDM mice (in plasma, sWAT, and vWAT), with correlations to metabolic and blood pressure markers.
cross-section timing: At delivery (for human GDM vs control comparison), and across trimesters for general expression profiles (in mice and patients).
